title: Canonical codec moves to @inventarch/graph
summary: canonical, digest, copy and CodecError are exported from @inventarch/graph beside stableSerialize; @inventarch/session-system re-exports them (SessionError now extends CodecError; refusal codes are unchanged) and depends on graph; @inventarch/distribution imports the codec from graph and no longer depends on session-system. Digests are byte-identical, pinned by a vector test; workspace revisions are untouched.
